The effectiveness of Yom Kippur depends on how individuals integrate its lessons into daily life. If approached with genuine commitment, it can be transformative, leading to a more mindful and intentional approach to actions and relationships throughout the year. Thus, Yom Kippur can indeed change how seriously people take their mistakes, fostering a culture of introspection and growth beyond just one day.
